decisionsTitle: The «Înscrieri» badge counts the confirmed with the waiting beside it, and the summary's pills are filters (amending §255, §476, §621 and §246)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-01, the race's first evening**, on the tab that read 167 while the list's summary read 168 and 133 were confirmed: the badge should be the confirmed count, and beside it «pune pilluri cu iconițe și cu numerele» for the people waiting; then, looking at the list's summary strip, «Și aceste pilluri trebuie sa fie clickable (filtre)».

**What was wrong.** §621 made the tooltip say that the badge counts people with a registration in progress, not places. That was honest and still wrong for a club that reads the tab as «câți sunt siguri»: 167 mixed the 133 who are confirmed, the 10 who wait and 24 in between (awaiting the email, the signature, an offer), and the strip's pills below it, which say the same states one by one, could be read but not used: to see the ten on the waiting list a person had to open the filter fold and choose a state.

**Decision — Part A, the tab.**

- The badge number is the people with a **CONFIRMED** registration, real ones, at the upcoming events the breakdown already covers (not cancelled, not past, `kind` REAL; a test registration is in no figure, §12.6).
- Beside it a second, smaller pill: the waiting list's hourglass (the glyph `queue` wears on the «Coada» panel and the line title, registered as `waiting` in `shared/ui/action-icons.ts`, §318: one glyph table, no new import in a component) and the number of people waiting. Drawn only above zero; outlined in the club's secondary colour so it reads as the lesser figure; `role="img"` with the words «10 pe lista de așteptare» for a screen reader (the glyph and the number are drawn only). Both pills sit in the one focusable chunk the tooltip hangs on. At 320 pixels the tab bar is `variant="scrollable"`, so the pill lengthens the row, never the page; a rendered-markup test holds the pill's shape, and nothing was measured in a browser. No fallback to one badge was needed.
- «Waiting» is the allocator's bucket and not the bare WAITLISTED status: an offer that has lapsed and not yet been swept holds no place and is going back to the list, so it counts there, as the tooltip's per-event line has counted it since §621. The three figures — confirmed, waiting and **in progress** (everybody else with an active registration: awaiting the email, awaiting the signature, an unlapsed offer, a family's reservation) — add up to the old total, so nobody is dropped by the change and the tooltip cannot disagree with the tab.
- The tooltip's first line is the three figures in one line, replacing §621's sentence: «Confirmați: 133 · pe lista de așteptare: 10 · în curs: 24» («Confirmed: 133 · on the waiting list: 10 · in progress: 24»). The per-event lines stay as §621 wrote them («Cursa: 153 — 144 cu loc din 150, 9 așteaptă confirmarea emailului»); «cu loc» still includes the confirmed, so the two read the same people. No noun meets a number that inflects, so no `countForm`.
- Still one grouped query with the one-minute memo: the bucket expression gained a `confirmed` branch (the confirmed split out of «place»), `RegisteredOnEvent` gained `confirmed`, and `registeredBadgeBreakdown` returns `{ total, confirmed, waitlisted, inProgress, events }`, each a sum of the split. `registeredBadgeHint` takes those figures and its `rule` word is a function of the three numbers. `countRegisteredForUpcoming` stays: it is the whole the three must add up to.

**Decision — Part B, the summary's pills.**

- Every pill of the «Cine s-a înscris» strip is a link to the same page with `status=<RegistrationStatus>` in the address, server-rendered (`SummaryStrip`, a Server Component; each pill a `ChipLink`, an `<a>` with the whole query, no island of its own, working with JavaScript off, like the start list's paging §250). The state in force is drawn pressed (filled, `color="primary"`, `aria-current="page"`) and links to the page without `status`, so a second press clears it; the total pill («Înscrieri: 168 …») links to the page without it too, and is the pressed one while no state is chosen. The pill of the state in force is drawn even when nobody is in it, so the filter that emptied the list can be pressed off. A press keeps the reader where they are (`keepScroll`): the list under the strip is what changes.
- `summaryPillHref(basePath, current, status | null)` (`registrations/domain/summary-filter-links.ts`) is pure and keeps an **allowlist** of the list's own keys — the event, the search, club-member, bounced, offers, the sort and the page size — and drops everything else: `saved`, `error`, `cancelled`, `erased`, `failed`, `sent`, `erase` (which would reopen the erase panel), `marked`, `voided`, `test`, `until`, `stop`, `gmail`, `held` and the page number (a filter lands on the first page). An allowlist, because a list of what to drop needs a new row for every message a screen invents.
- The strip stays blind to the status filter (§246): the page still groups without it, so no count moves when a pill is pressed. The test rows' pill stays a label: `kind` is no status. The «Caută și filtrează» select reads the same address through the page's own `isRegistrationStatus` (an unreadable `status` shows «Toate» there and presses no pill, instead of a value the select has no option for), and its fold opens and says «filtre active» while a state is chosen, as for every other filter (§269). **The form is keyed by the address the list was resolved from** (`key={listQueryString}`): a pill is a soft `next/link` navigation, the page's client tree stays mounted, and MUI's select reads its `defaultValue` once, so without the key the select kept saying «Toate» after a pill was pressed and the next «Filtrează» sent `status=` and dropped the state the pill had set. A new address is a new form; every field (the search, the event, the club-member, bounced and offers filters, the state) starts from what the address says, after a pill, after «Șterge» and after a toggle-off alike. `ChipLink` gained a `wrap` flag so the total's long sentence wraps at 320 pixels instead of being cut.
- Authorization is unchanged: the links lead to the same page under the same role checks.

**Refused.** Keeping the old badge and adding the confirmed beside it (two numbers for one tab is the confusion §621 spent a tooltip on); counting the bare WAITLISTED status and leaving the lapsed offer in no figure (the three would no longer add up, and a person would vanish between them); a client island for the pills or a `router.push` (the strip is a link, and a link is what survives a reload and a bookmark); carrying every query key a link was built with (the flash messages would come back); a new icon import in the tab (the registry is the one table).

**Tests.** Integration `registrations/nav-count.test.ts`: the confirmed figure and the waiting figure with a test row, a cancelled row and a past event in neither, the lapsed offer among the waiting, the three summing to the total, the per-event `confirmed` and the `withPlace` that still contains it, a zero waiting list; the hint's words in both locales with the owner's figures. Unit `registrations/summary-filter-links.test.ts`: the allowlist, the toggle, the total, an unreadable state, empty values. Unit `registrations/summary-strip.test.ts`: rendered markup, every pill an anchor with the expected href, the pressed one, the counts unchanged across pressed states, the zero state in force drawn, no script or button. Unit `staff/admin-tabs-waiting-pill.test.ts`: the pill's glyph, number, name, only above zero, inside the tooltip's chunk. `shared/action-icons.test.ts` holds that `waiting` is used and names no other glyph. End to end, `promo-filter.spec.ts` (320 pixels on the mobile project, the laptop on the other): a state pill narrows the rows, is `aria-current`, measures 44 pixels, leaves no sideways scroll; the select's value follows it; «Filtrează» keeps the state; a second press clears it and the select says «Toate» again. That step is what a rendered-markup test of the strip alone cannot see.
changelogLine: - **«Înscrieri» counts the confirmed, with the waiting beside it; the summary's pills are filters** — the tab's badge is the confirmed (133, not 167) and a small hourglass pill beside it says how many wait; its tooltip reads «Confirmați: 133 · pe lista de așteptare: 10 · în curs: 24». On the list, every pill of «Cine s-a înscris» is a link to that state, the pressed one clears it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 109, 110 and 186 (the tab's figure is the confirmed alone, not the sum of the per-event split, and the tooltip's first line is the three figures, not a rule). The «Înscrieri» tab's badge is the number of real CONFIRMED registrations at the upcoming events, never a test row; beside it a second, smaller pill with the waiting list's hourglass and the number of people waiting (a lapsed offer included) is drawn only above zero and is named for a screen reader; the tooltip's first line says the three figures, confirmed, on the waiting list and in progress, which add up to the people with an active registration, and each event's line is unchanged; one grouped query and the one-minute memo (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Every pill of the registrations list's summary strip is a server-rendered link to the same page with `status` set, keeping the event, the search and the other list filters and carrying no one-shot message or page number; the pill of the state in force is drawn pressed and links to the page without it, the total links to the page without it, a state in force with nobody in it is still drawn, the strip's counts do not change with the pressed state, and the panel's status select shows the same state after a press, which is verified in the running app, not only on the strip's markup (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the «Înscrieri» badge counts the confirmed with the waiting beside it; the summary's pills are filters
